remarks: Fantastic opportunity to customize this space to suit your vision. Currently used as hair salon and ideally suited for similar venture or other retail types of uses. It offers approximately 600 sq.ft. of open space, high ceilings and a private restroom. Post Road location with high traffic and strong visibility. It is surrounded by a variety of businesses and amenities. This location is attractive and convenient from highway, public transportation, nearby residents and walk-ins. Zoned C-L (limited commercial district) Tenant must perform their diligence and is responsible for improvements and renovations. Flexible lease- Excellent credit score and job history is a must.
